title: Refuse review admission when the PR head does not close its ticket
body: Outcome: krn review --pr (before reserving an attempt) and krn deliver --dry-run refuse when tasks/<ticket>.json at the exact head is not closed, so the close commit lands before review instead of needing a follow-up PR or a second attempt. Evidence: PR #166 merged c1ef7c7 with t-75qhb77 still open; the lead skill requires the close commit as the PR's last commit.
